selection: Eight new configurations; primary accuracy policy also permits cached baseline. Rank by pooled inner correct, macro-F1, then fixed order. No search expansion based on outer scores.
preprocessing: Only original AV columns384:512 get rank-Gaussian or median/IQR asinh transform. Fit every transform, StandardScaler and PCA on relevant training participants only. Rank endpoint .5/Nfit, no subsampling; asinh zero-IQR fallback fitting std then1. Fixed square-root inverse class weights. Text unchanged before ordinary scaling/PCA.
features: Original MiniLM384 + audio78 + visual50. No questionnaire, score, severity, ID, age or gender inference features. All rows retained. No synthetic data.
evaluation: Original 163 people, 5 outer x 3 inner folds, seeds42/137/2026. No new validation/test scoring. Final config uses cached inner predictions only. Bootstrap participants jointly across all three predictions. All comparisons remain exploratory after dataset reuse.
stopping_rule: One new robust-preprocessing study; eight configs, fifteen outer jobs, at most two full-training fits. Target +2 percentage points; no guaranteed gain.
